_README.title: ETF Fund Flows (Derived)
_README.description: Daily derived ETF flow estimates per ticker (AUM/NAV + return adjustment).
_README.purpose: Track daily creation/redemption activity (fund flows) and aggregate by asset class/category/subcategory.

methodology.overview: Flows are derived by isolating changes in AUM not explained by market performance.
notes: AUM and NAV are sourced from yfinance when available (Ticker.info keys: totalAssets, navPrice).
Close prices are sourced from yfinance in a batched request to minimize API calls.
Optional fallbacks can be configured (e.g., Alpha Vantage ETF_PROFILE provides net_assets).
Differences vs paid providers can occur (NAV vs close basis, corporate actions, smoothing around holidays).
